title: 残暴上击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：左、右、上、左。用重武器连续变换攻势，最后从下方施展残暴的上击。
second_page: 残暴上击对刺击、打击和斩击伤害均有强化。命中腿部时攻击膝盖，命中其他部位时则视为击中脸部。翻到这里，你已经开始练习残暴上击。

en_us.title: Brutal Uppercut
en_us.first_page: Input: Left, Right, Up, Left. Change the line of attack with a heavy weapon, then finish with a brutal rising blow from below.
en_us.second_page: Brutal Uppercut strengthens thrust, strike, and slash damage alike. Leg hits target the knee; all other hits count as strikes to the face.
